summary: RentaFlow SaaS backend is fully functional (17/17 pytest pass covering auth, vehicles, customers, reservations with double-booking + RES-YYYY-NNNNN generation, payments with status transitions + admin-only delete + paid_amount revert, dashboard stats, reports summary, CSV export, logout, staff RBAC). Frontend login + sidebar routing + dashboard all render correctly visually, but `data-testid` attributes are MISSING across the entire UI, preventing the testid-based automation required by the review spec.

minor.issue: JWT cookies set with secure=False and samesite='lax'; cross-site cookie flow relies on allow_origin_regex='.*' which works for same-parent-domain preview but may fail on strict browsers. Consider SameSite=None + Secure for production.

gen_reservation_number uses count_documents which is not atomic — concurrent inserts could produce duplicates (though unique index prevents DB collision, user gets 500). Consider findAndModify counter.
Date comparison uses string $gte/$lte on ISO dates (works) but the third $and clause should use $lte/$gte swapped: {pickup_date<=start AND return_date>=end} — currently correct; verified passes.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing data-testid on email/password/submit inputs. Spec expected login-email, login-password, login-submit.
NavLinks missing data-testid. Spec expected nav-tablero, nav-reservas, nav-calendario, nav-clientes, nav-vehiculos, nav-pagos, nav-reportes.
Add/Save/Delete buttons and form inputs lack data-testid attributes — cannot be reliably automated.

issues: Contraseña field appears pre-filled with dots on fresh load — may be browser autofill, but verify no hardcoded value in Login.jsx initial state.

action_items: Add data-testid attributes across frontend per spec: login-email, login-password, login-submit, nav-tablero, nav-reservas, nav-calendario, nav-clientes, nav-vehiculos, nav-pagos, nav-reportes, logout-btn, plus vehicle-add-btn, customer-add-btn, reservation-add-btn, payment-add-btn, form fields (vehicle-name, vehicle-plate, etc.) and save/delete buttons.
Verify Login.jsx has no default password value (observed dots in password field on initial render).
Optional: make gen_reservation_number atomic (use db.counters findAndModify) to avoid 500s under concurrency.
Optional: set cookies with secure=True + SameSite=None for stricter browsers in production.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 740 lines monolith — consider splitting into routers (auth, vehicles, customers, reservations, payments, reports).
Duplicate enrichment logic (customer_name, vehicle_name lookup) repeated 4+ times in list_reservations, dashboard_stats, reservations_calendar, export_csv — extract helper.
pending_payments loop iterates all reservations in Python instead of Mongo aggregation — will not scale.
check_overlap loads all active reservations for a vehicle into Python instead of using Mongo $or query — fine for small data but inefficient.
test_credentials: admin@rentcar.com/admin123 and staff@rentcar.com/staff123 — both valid, verified in backend tests.
seed_data_creation: All test data prefixed TEST_ and cleaned up via fixture teardown. Auto-seeded admin+staff users remain from startup hook.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully covered by /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (reusable regression). Frontend could not be automated via data-testid because they are absent — next run should retest UI after E1 adds testids. Login field selectors that work today: input[type=email], input[type=password], button:has-text('Iniciar sesión'). Sidebar text labels: Tablero/Reservas/Calendario/Clientes/Vehículos/Pagos/Reportes. Logout text: 'Cerrar sesión'.
